prerequisite: Do not publish/dispatch until the exact corrected compiler gate and independent control source review succeed. This file grants no waiver.

primitives.adaptation: Only hosted guards, bounded PID-filtered AT-SPI traversal, Openbox/AT-SPI bootstrap, lossless pixel conversion and owned-descendant cleanup are adapted. Capture is split from geometry, cleanup adds stamped identities. No held-pane fixture/helper/schema/pin/claims or HOME override transfers.

settings:
schema_version = 3
app_theme = "dark"
ui_scale = 1.5
terminal_font_size = 14.0
show_status_bar = false
check_for_updates = false
limits: Source-only temporary research control; never merge. No local Cargo, native app, helper, provider, fixture or workflow execution is authorized while preparing it.

Actual scripts/run-development --browserless builds matched CLI/HOST/UI separately with development features in one shared dev-runtime target, CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2, serial arms. It does not establish integrated-browser or whole-feature suite acceptance.

Inherited HOME and CODEX_HOME remain unchanged. Only private XDG/TMP app state, editor-stub PATH prefix and task-specific Cargo/Rustup cache variables are used. Inherited authority and scale variables are never stripped or fabricated.

Physical windows/captures must actually measure1280x800 and900x600, with identical supported ui_scale1.5 settings and Xvfb96DPI configuration. Current internal native scale factor is UNMEASURED; no derived current600x400 viewport is claimed. Initial winit scale guess is supporting startup evidence only.

Twelve same-path synthetic real Git projects are opened through matched --no-start CLI in reverse12→01 order because production ordering is newest-first. No remotes, provider or synthetic IPC fixture is used.

Baseline is a whole-feature comparison with14 action rows versus product15; it is not an isolated reproduction of the later wheel regression. Actual failed baseline cases remain failures and later baseline cases remain UNRUN; separate after app state restores initial comparability without repairing the failed trial.

Pure native pixel capture after wheel never resizes, moves, focuses or repairs pointer. Return/space/click use actual XTest input; only native X11 line-wheel buttons4/5 are covered, not pixel/touchpad/physical-keyboard/Wayland/touch/submenu/right-edge menu behavior.

Safe Remove confirmation is observed only and cancelled; no destructive confirmation is activated. Name/path must lie within the bounded native modal content region, with initially focused Cancel. Independent actual-image review must validate that bounded region.

Tooltip five-image states and every native UX claim require independent review. Missing tooltip accessibility labels do not establish absence. No source or machine result alone grants native UX acceptance.
No live commercial provider, concurrent-agent workload, performance/frame/GPU/resource improvement, FW16 compositor or full-PR merge acceptance is established. Remaining PR gates are not waived.

Actual logs, exits, source/executable/config/fixture hashes, PID-filtered accessibility, ordered input/keycode receipts, geometry, native WebPs and cleanup failures are retained. Missing captures are explicit; no placeholder or invented pass.

Owned process identities are captured before waits and revalidated before signals; normal UI close and matched guarded private daemon stop precede final owned cleanup. Cleanup failure refuses the next arm/build. Screenshots remain artifacts only, off product branches.
product_successor_note: Public independently reviewed test-only E0282 correction of Vec<keyboard::Key> inference. Production/native behavior is unchanged; compiler gate still must succeed at this exact successor.
